description: Same as create_project, for apps that order builds for their customers, but it answers as soon as the build has started (status building, with the projectId): poll get_build_status, then get_result for the delivery link. `idempotencyKey` (e.g. the order id) makes a retry return the same build instead of building twice. Spends credits, so it is two-step: this call returns needs_confirmation with the price and a confirmToken; show the summary to the user, then call confirm_action with the token to run it. Counts against this connection's daily credit cap.

engine.description: babylon: build with the 3D game engine; none: the site/app builder; unset: decided from the prompt

tier.description: Model tier, default standard. fast: a small model, 6 credits a build / 3 a change, apps and games only, simpler results; standard: Claude Sonnet, 21 / 10; best: Claude Opus, 81 / 40, slower.
